description: Identity, access control, and the user/progress domain with structural child-data protection. Covers auth (JWT + bcrypt + Roles guard/decorator), users (profiles + caregiver<->learner links with a single caregiver-access enforcement point), progress (ownership-scoped read/write of ProgressRecord), and DPDP-aligned data export/delete endpoints. One coherent feature because every piece shares the CaregiverAccessService choke point and the repository tokens from FEAT-001. Depends on FEAT-001; independent of FEAT-002.
steps: Auth: create apps/api/src/auth/auth.service.ts (register: hash password with bcrypt, create User via UserRepository; validateUser: compare bcrypt; login: sign a JWT with sub=userId, role via @nestjs/jwt using JWT_SECRET from env). Create jwt.strategy.ts (passport-jwt, extract Bearer token, validate -> { userId, role }). Create jwt-auth.guard.ts (AuthGuard('jwt')). Create roles.decorator.ts (@Roles(...UserRole[]) via SetMetadata) and roles.guard.ts (reads required roles from reflector, compares to request.user.role; allow if no roles required or user role is included). Create current-user.decorator.ts (@CurrentUser() param decorator reading request.user). Create auth.controller.ts (POST /api/auth/register, POST /api/auth/login) and auth.module.ts (registers JwtModule, PassportModule, exports AuthService + guards). Import AuthModule in app.module.ts.

Auth tests: apps/api/src/auth/roles.guard.spec.ts — guard allows when user.role is in @Roles list, denies (ForbiddenException/false) when not, allows when no @Roles metadata present. apps/api/src/auth/auth.service.spec.ts — register hashes the password (stored hash != plaintext), validateUser accepts correct password and rejects wrong password.

Users + caregiver access: create apps/api/src/users/caregiver-access.service.ts with canAccess(actorId, actorRole, subjectUserId): boolean — true if actorId === subjectUserId, OR actorRole === 'admin', OR a CaregiverLink(caregiverId=actorId, learnerId=subjectUserId) exists via CaregiverLinkRepository. This is the SINGLE enforcement point; users and progress must call only this, no ad-hoc checks. Create users.service.ts (get/update profile; linkLearner/unlinkLearner creating CaregiverLink; createMinorAccount that requires a caregiver actor — minor accounts are caregiver-mediated, data-minimising: store only what is needed). Create users.controller.ts guarded by JwtAuthGuard (+ RolesGuard where appropriate); every route that targets another user's data calls CaregiverAccessService.canAccess and throws ForbiddenException on false.

DPDP data rights: create apps/api/src/users/data-rights.controller.ts with GET /api/users/:id/export (returns the user's profile + their progress records as a JSON bundle) and DELETE /api/users/:id (deletes the user, their links, and their progress). Both authorised through CaregiverAccessService.canAccess (self, linked caregiver, or admin). Add a short comment noting DPDP 2025 alignment (data minimisation, exportable/deletable data, no behavioural ad profiling).

Users tests: apps/api/src/users/caregiver-access.service.spec.ts — self allowed; admin allowed; caregiver linked to learner allowed; unrelated/unlinked caregiver denied. apps/api/src/users/users.service.spec.ts — linkLearner then canAccess true; createMinorAccount requires a caregiver and auto-links.

Create apps/api/src/users/users.module.ts (provides UsersService, CaregiverAccessService; declares UsersController, DataRightsController; imports PersistenceModule; exports CaregiverAccessService) and import it in app.module.ts.

Progress: create apps/api/src/progress/progress.service.ts — getProgress(actor, subjectUserId) and setProgress(actor, subjectUserId, { phaseId, itemKey, status }) where status is 'not-started'|'in-progress'|'completed'; BOTH call CaregiverAccessService.canAccess first and throw ForbiddenException when false; records use the mirrored ProgressRecord shape and go through ProgressRepository. Create progress.controller.ts (GET /api/progress/:userId, PUT /api/progress/:userId) JwtAuthGuard-protected, passing req.user as actor. Create progress.module.ts (imports PersistenceModule + UsersModule for CaregiverAccessService) and import it in app.module.ts.

Progress test: apps/api/src/progress/progress.service.spec.ts — owner can read and write own progress; a caregiver linked to the learner can read/write the learner's progress; an unrelated user is denied (ForbiddenException) on both read and write.
acceptance_criteria: RolesGuard allows a request whose user.role is in the @Roles list and denies one that is not; passes through when no roles are required.
Passwords are stored bcrypt-hashed; validateUser rejects an incorrect password.
CaregiverAccessService.canAccess returns true for self, admin, and a caregiver linked to the learner, and false for an unlinked actor — and it is the only place this rule is implemented.
Progress read and write are permitted only for the owner or a linked caregiver/admin; unrelated actors get ForbiddenException.
There are endpoints to export and to delete a user's data, authorised through CaregiverAccessService.
From apps/api, npm run build and npm test pass.
verification: cd apps/api; npm test  (roles.guard.spec, auth.service.spec, caregiver-access.service.spec, users.service.spec, progress.service.spec all pass)
cd apps/api; npm run build  (expect exit 0)
findings:
COMPLETE. Verified from apps/api: `npm run build` exits 0; `npm test` green (9 suites, 43 tests — includes roles.guard.spec, auth.service.spec, caregiver-access.service.spec, users.service.spec, progress.service.spec). All files under apps/api; packages/*, tools/, apps/web, apps/mobile untouched. In-memory repos used (no DB/network).

AUTH (src/auth/):
- AuthService (auth.service.ts): register(RegisterDto)->AuthResult (bcrypt hash, rounds=10, rejects duplicate email with ConflictException); validateUser(email,password)->Promise<User|null> (bcrypt.compare); login(LoginDto)->AuthResult (UnauthorizedException on bad creds). JWT payload interface JwtPayload { sub:string; role:UserRole }. AuthResult { accessToken:string; user:{id,email,displayName,role} }.
- JwtStrategy (jwt.strategy.ts): passport-jwt, Bearer extraction, secret from getJwtSecret(). validate()-> AuthenticatedUser { userId:string; role:UserRole } (EXPORTED interface — this is request.user shape used everywhere).
- GUARDS: JwtAuthGuard (jwt-auth.guard.ts, extends AuthGuard('jwt')); RolesGuard (roles.guard.ts, impl CanActivate, reads ROLES_KEY via Reflector.getAllAndOverride over [handler,class]; passes through when no/empty roles; throws ForbiddenException when role not in list).
- DECORATORS: @Roles(...UserRole[]) (roles.decorator.ts, SetMetadata key ROLES_KEY='roles'); @CurrentUser() (current-user.decorator.ts, param decorator returning request.user as AuthenticatedUser).
- AuthController (auth.controller.ts): POST /api/auth/register, POST /api/auth/login (login @HttpCode 200). DTOs in auth/dto.ts: RegisterDto {email,password(min8),displayName,role?(self-registerable: learner|parent|guardian|educator),isMinor?}; LoginDto {email,password}.
- AuthModule imports PassportModule + JwtModule.register({secret:getJwtSecret(), signOptions:{expiresIn:'1d'}}); exports AuthService, JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard, JwtModule. Relies on global PersistenceModule for USER_REPOSITORY.

CAREGIVER ACCESS CHOKE POINT (src/users/caregiver-access.service.ts): CaregiverAccessService.canAccess(actorId: string, actorRole: UserRole, subjectUserId: string): Promise<boolean> — returns true if actorId===subjectUserId (self) OR actorRole==='admin' OR CaregiverLinkRepository.exists(actorId, subjectUserId). This is the SINGLE enforcement point; UsersService and ProgressService call ONLY this (no ad-hoc checks). Exported from UsersModule.

USERS (src/users/):
- UsersService (users.service.ts): getProfile(actor,id)/updateProfile(actor,id,{displayName}) [both assertAccess via choke point], linkLearner(actor,learnerId), unlinkLearner(actor,learnerId), createMinorAccount(actor,CreateMinorDto) [requires caregiver role parent|guardian|educator|admin else ForbiddenException; creates isMinor=true learner, auto-links to actor; data-minimising], exportData(actor,id)->DataExportBundle {profile,progress,exportedAt}, deleteData(actor,id) [deletes progress, all links both directions, then user]. PublicProfile {id,email,displayName,role,isMinor} never exposes passwordHash. actor param type is AuthenticatedUser.
- UsersController (users.controller.ts) @Controller('users') @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard,RolesGuard): POST /api/users/links {learnerId} (@Roles caregivers, 204), DELETE /api/users/links/:learnerId (204), POST /api/users/minors (CreateMinorDto, @Roles caregivers), GET /api/users/:id, PATCH /api/users/:id (UpdateProfileDto).
- DataRightsController (data-rights.controller.ts) @Controller('users') @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard): GET /api/users/:id/export -> DataExportBundle; DELETE /api/users/:id (204). DPDP 2025 aligned. NOTE two controllers share 'users' prefix but routes don't collide.
- DTOs (users/dto.ts): UpdateProfileDto {displayName?}; CreateMinorDto {displayName, email?, password?}; LinkLearnerDto {learnerId}.
- UsersModule imports AuthModule; providers UsersService+CaregiverAccessService; controllers UsersController+DataRightsController; exports CaregiverAccessService + UsersService.

PROGRESS (src/progress/):
- ProgressService (progress.service.ts): getProgress(actor,subjectUserId)->ProgressRecord[]; setProgress(actor,subjectUserId,SetProgressDto)->ProgressRecord. BOTH call CaregiverAccessService.canAccess first, throw ForbiddenException on false. Writes set updatedAt=new Date().toISOString() and upsert via ProgressRepository.
- ProgressController (progress.controller.ts) @Controller('progress') @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard): GET /api/progress/:userId, PUT /api/progress/:userId (SetProgressDto {phaseId,itemKey,status:'not-started'|'in-progress'|'completed'}).
- ProgressModule imports AuthModule + UsersModule (for CaregiverAccessService).

REPOSITORY ADDITION (needed for profile edits; all under apps/api): added UserRepository.save(user: User): Promise<User> to persistence/repositories.ts, implemented in InMemoryUserRepository (Map.set by id) and PrismaUserRepository (db.user.update). Added `update(args:{where,data})` to PrismaModelDelegate in prisma.service.ts. These are additive; existing FEAT-001 signatures unchanged.

APP WIRING: app.module.ts imports AuthModule, UsersModule, ProgressModule (after ContentModule). All guarded controllers rely on JwtStrategy registered in AuthModule; AuthModule re-exported where needed.

FOR LATER STEPS: request.user shape is AuthenticatedUser {userId, role} (NOT {sub}). Import guards/decorators from '../auth/*'. Reuse CaregiverAccessService (exported by UsersModule) for any new user-scoped access — do not add ad-hoc checks. ProgressRecord status strings use hyphens ('not-started'|'in-progress'|'completed').
